entries.summary: 2026-11-16 00:22 EST: Bearish — Elevated Downside Risk unchanged for November 16–18. Asian semiconductor selling adds caution, but earlier Nasdaq futures +0.5% is only indicative; no Monday US cash reaction. Reuters Brent $95.30 and WTI $88.34 Monday indications are asynchronous. No synchronized VXN/VIX, comprehensive breadth, official paired Treasury yields or direct CME FedWatch. Open Watch 163 events, last updated November 13.
bullish: Nasdaq futures +0.5% in early Reuters Monday reporting; tentative, not confirmed cash rebound.
SOX reported +8.1% prior week despite Friday -3.4%; potential rebound capacity.
Reuters Monday Brent $95.30 and WTI $88.34; easing oil and IEA projected Q4 surplus mitigate inflation risk.
Positive Nvidia guidance with stronger SOX, breadth and easing yields could invalidate bearish outlook.
bearish: Friday Nasdaq -0.91%, QQQ -1.19%, SOX approximately -3.4%: concentrated technology weakness.
WSJ Monday reports Asian chip-equipment losses Advantest -9.4%, Lasertec -8.8% and Kospi -2.0%; asynchronous Asian-session indications, not US cash reaction.
Reported Friday Treasury 10Y 5.133% and 2Y 4.850% imply +28.3 basis points; elevated rates weigh on growth valuations.
Nvidia Tuesday earnings and Wednesday FOMC minutes bring high gap and rate risk.
Hormuz tanker-mine claims remain unverified; physical oil disruption not confirmed.

editorial.marketOverview: Friday's Nasdaq -0.91%, QQQ -1.19% and SOX about -3.4% remain latest U.S. cash evidence. Earlier Monday Nasdaq futures +0.5% suggest tentative stabilization, but Asian chip-equipment shares subsequently weakened in asynchronous reporting. Neither alone proves Monday U.S. direction.
editorial.whatChanged: Compared with the 23:22 EST assessment, WSJ reports Advantest -9.4%, Lasertec -8.8% and Kospi -2.0% during Asian trade. Reuters reports Brent $95.30 and WTI $88.34 as Monday indications. Open Watch remains at 163 events last updated November 13. These observations do not establish a material change to the expected three-day path.
editorial.marketInterpretation: Chip fragility, Nvidia governance/export uncertainty and elevated rates continue to dominate. WSJ reported 10Y 5.133% and 2Y 4.850% imply +28.3bp, correctly scaled; a separate Friday daily table shows 5.15% and 4.88%, implying +27bp. These are not synchronized official quotes. VXN/VIX, full Nasdaq breadth and live CME FedWatch remain unverified.
editorial.threeDayPath: Monday Nov 16: Empire Manufacturing 08:30 ET, then watch the first U.S. QQQ/SOX reaction and breadth. Tuesday Nov 17: retail sales 08:30 ET, industrial production 09:15 ET and Nvidia after-close earnings. Wednesday Nov 18: housing starts 08:30 ET, first cash response to Nvidia results and FOMC minutes 14:00 ET. Choppy sideways-to-lower remains base case without semiconductor and breadth confirmation.
editorial.bullCase: Sustained QQQ/SOX recovery, improving breadth, contained oil, easing Treasury yields and VXN/VIX, and reassuring Nvidia guidance could invalidate elevated downside risk. Earlier positive futures are not sufficient confirmation.
editorial.bearCase: Failed bounce, continued SOX weakness, rising yields or volatility, weak macro data or disappointing Nvidia guidance would reinforce downside. Asian chip declines are a warning rather than a verified U.S. reaction. Independently confirmed Hormuz disruption could create an oil-driven inflation shock; tanker claims remain unverified.
editorial.watchNext: Verify 08:30 ET Empire Manufacturing, then synchronize Nasdaq/QQQ, SOX, breadth, VXN/VIX, official 10Y/2Y yields, Brent/WTI and CME FedWatch. Monitor Open Watch updates and Tuesday Nvidia/retail sales and Wednesday FOMC minutes.
